svg.aria-label: A wrong attempt at 3x + 7 = 22 gets reward 0, and the same credit lands on every token.
svg.text: The plus gets exactly the same push as 3x, =, 22 and 7, which were right.
Nothing in one number can say which token made the answer wrong.
The student wrote every token being graded.
One grade for the whole attempt.
GRPO also divides by the group standard deviation; the sign and the sameness across tokens do not change.
